```{=html}
<div id="map-jul27" class="day-map"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var map = L.map('map-jul27').setView([37.5580, 126.9730], 13);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution: '© <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a>'
  }).addTo(map);
  function dot(c) {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:'+c+';border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.4)"></div>', iconSize:[13,13], iconAnchor:[6,6], popupAnchor:[0,-8] });
  }
  function hotelDot() {
    return L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#4A148C;border:2.5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:#fff">★</div>', iconSize:[22,22], iconAnchor:[11,11], popupAnchor:[0,-13] });
  }
  var pts = [
    { name:'Shilla Stay Seodaemun Seoul Station 🏨', lat:37.5572, lng:126.9680, hotel:true, url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Shilla+Stay+Seodaemun+Seoul+Station' },
    { name:'Myeongdong 🛒', lat:37.5636, lng:126.9834, c:'#E53935', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Myeongdong+Seoul' },
    { name:'Gwangjang Market 🥟', lat:37.5698, lng:126.9993, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gwangjang+Market+Seoul' },
    { name:'Gamekol Son Wangmandu 🥟', lat:37.5700, lng:126.9985, c:'#43A047', url:'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Gamekol+Son+Wangmandu+Seoul' },
  ];
  L.polyline([[37.5572, 126.9680], [37.5698, 126.9993]], { color:'#7B1FA2', weight:3, opacity:0.8 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([(37.5572+37.5698)/2, (126.9680+126.9993)/2], {
    icon: L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="background:#7B1FA2;color:#fff;border-radius:50%;width:20px;height:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4)">1</div>', iconSize:[20,20], iconAnchor:[10,10] })
  }).addTo(map).bindPopup('<b>① Shilla Stay → Gwangjang Market</b><br>Line 5 · ~11 min');
  L.polyline([[37.5698, 126.9993], [37.5636, 126.9834]], { color:'#E65100', weight:3, opacity:0.8 }).addTo(map);
  L.marker([(37.5698+37.5636)/2, (126.9993+126.9834)/2], {
    icon: L.divIcon({ className:'', html:'<div style="background:#E65100;color:#fff;border-radius:50%;width:20px;height:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.4)">2</div>', iconSize:[20,20], iconAnchor:[10,10] })
  }).addTo(map).bindPopup('<b>② Gwangjang Market → Myeongdong</b><br>Bus 104 · ~13 min');

  window.pageMap = map; window.pageMarkers = [];
  pts.forEach(function(p) {
    var m = L.marker([p.lat, p.lng], { icon: p.hotel ? hotelDot() : dot(p.c) }).addTo(map);
    var html = '<b>' + p.name + '</b>';
    if (p.url) html += '<br><a href="' + p.url + '" target="_blank" style="font-size:12px">Open in Maps →</a>';
    m.bindPopup(html);
    window.pageMarkers.push({ marker: m, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng });
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<div class="event-card activity" style="border-color:#5C6BC0;background:#F8F8FF;margin-top:24px">
  <div class="event-time">💤</div>
  <div class="event-body">
    <div class="event-tags"><span class="tag activity">😴 Jet Lag Strategy</span></div>
    <div class="event-name">Arrival Day Sleep Plan — Survive Tonight</div>
    <div class="event-notes">
      You land at 16:05 KST but your body clock reads <strong>midnight Vancouver time</strong>. The key is to hold out until a reasonable Korean bedtime without crashing early. One bad nap now can knock your sleep schedule off for days.
      <div style="margin-top:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0">

        <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;background:#FFEBEE;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;border-left:4px solid #C62828">
          <div style="min-width:110px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#B71C1C">16:05–18:00 KST<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:#C62828">00:05–02:00 PDT</span></div>
          <div><strong>⚠️ Do NOT nap</strong> — even lying down "just for 20 min" will become 3 hours. Get the SIM, take the bus, check in, and go straight outside. Movement helps.</div>
        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;background:#FFF3E0;border-left:4px solid #E65100">
          <div style="min-width:110px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#E65100">18:00–21:00 KST<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:#E65100">02:00–05:00 PDT</span></div>
          <div><strong>Stay busy</strong> — Bright lights, food, and walking are your best friend right now. Eat a proper dinner even if you're not hungry.</div>
        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;background:#E8F5E9;border-left:4px solid #2E7D32">
          <div style="min-width:110px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#1B5E20">21:00–22:00 KST<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:#2E7D32">05:00–06:00 PDT</span></div>
          <div><strong>😴 Bedtime</strong> — this is your target. Take a melatonin (0.5–1mg), shower, black out the room. Don't fight it past 22:00 — earlier is fine.</div>
        </div>

        <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;background:#E3F2FD;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;border-left:4px solid #1565C0">
          <div style="min-width:110px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:#0D47A1">07:00–08:00 KST<br><span style="font-weight:400;color:#1565C0">15:00–16:00 PDT</span></div>
          <div><strong>Wake up</strong> — set an alarm. Your body clock will likely wake you earlier (Vancouver afternoon = Seoul early morning). Get up, open curtains, get sunlight. Day 2 starts fresh. ☀️</div>
        </div>

      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:#777">☀️ <strong>Sunlight is the strongest reset signal</strong> — get outside in the morning on Day 2 (Jul 28). Breakfast on the hotel terrace or a walk before the Gangnam day helps lock in your new rhythm.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="note-box"><strong>Breakfast included</strong> at hotel daily. · <strong>T-Money:</strong> comes free with your LG U+ SIM — top it up at any convenience store or subway machine.</div>
```
